channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−2.4).

item.title: [−1] Brent firms to $100.84 as Gulf and Red Sea attacks keep a risk premium despite better supply
item.description:
Brent rose 0.5% in Asian trade, reversing Monday's dip, as attacks on shipping near Yemen and Hormuz continued; crew pay near the strait has jumped. Brent is up about 3.8% in a month.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Fuel marketers squeezed

Why it matters: Crude near $100 keeps India's import bill, fuel inflation and rupee pressure high, squeezing airlines, fuel marketers and crude-linked manufacturers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Rupee slips to 96.41 per dollar as oil and US yields rise, reversing Monday's gain
item.description:
The rupee opened flat at 96.31 and weakened to 96.41 as crude firmed and US Treasury yields stayed high. The RBI is expected to smooth volatility. Reverses Monday's 10-paise gain.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Dollar crude costlier

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and adds to imported inflation, while lifting IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] India's LNG imports fall 14% in September; Oman becomes top supplier with a 27% share
item.description:
India imported 585,000 tonnes of LNG from Oman in September, overtaking the US, now third at 16%. Qatar's share fell after earlier damage at its main export hub. Ongoing supply diversification.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Tighter gas for city-gas firms

Why it matters: Lower LNG volumes tighten gas for city-gas distributors, fertiliser plants and industry, while diversification reduces dependence on the Hormuz route.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
